db:select.db:sql: SELECT T.SUB_ID AS CUENTA_FACTURACION, VI.INV_ID, SUM(T.AMT) AS MONTO_DETALLE, Y.TRANS_NM AS CONCEPTO_FACTURA, VI.STRT_DT, VI.END_DT FROM WASABI.V_TRANS T JOIN WASABI.V_TRANS_TYP Y ON Y.TRANS_TYP = T.TRANS_TYP JOIN V_INV VI ON VI.INV_ID = T.INV_ID WHERE VI.SUB_ID = :cuentaFacturacion AND VI.INV_ID = (SELECT MAX(INV_ID) FROM V_INV WHERE SUB_ID = VI.SUB_ID) GROUP BY T.SUB_ID, VI.INV_ID, Y.TRANS_NM, VI.STRT_DT, VI.END_DT

SELECT T.SUB_ID CUENTA_FACTURACION, sum(T.AMT)MONTO_DETALLE, T.INV_ID INV_ID, Y.TRANS_NM CONCEPTO_FACTURA, VI.STRT_DT, VI.END_DT
FROM WASABI.V_TRANS T, WASABI.V_TRANS_TYP Y , V_INV VI WHERE Y.TRANS_TYP = T.TRANS_TYP AND T.INV_ID = VI.INV_ID AND VI.EXT_INV_ID = ( SELECT ext_inv_id FROM ( SELECT factura.ext_inv_id FROM wasabi.v_inv factura JOIN ( SELECT srvc.sub_id FROM wasabi.v_ct_ct_num ctn JOIN wasabi.v_srvc_ct sct ON ctn.srvc_ct_id = sct.srvc_ct_id JOIN wasabi.v_srvc srvc ON sct.srvc_id = srvc.srvc_id WHERE ctn.stat = 'A' AND ctn.ct_num = :numeroConexion ) cuenta ON factura.sub_id = cuenta.sub_id ORDER BY factura.inv_id DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1 ) GROUP BY T.SUB_ID, t.inv_id, Y.TRANS_NM,VI.STRT_DT, VI.END_DT

SELECT T.SUB_ID CUENTA_FACTURACION, sum(T.AMT)MONTO_DETALLE, T.INV_ID INV_ID, Y.TRANS_NM CONCEPTO_FACTURA, VI.STRT_DT, VI.END_DT
FROM WASABI.V_TRANS T, WASABI.V_TRANS_TYP Y , V_INV VI WHERE Y.TRANS_TYP = T.TRANS_TYP AND T.INV_ID = VI.INV_ID AND VI.EXT_INV_ID = :numeroFactura GROUP BY T.SUB_ID, t.inv_id, Y.TRANS_NM,VI.STRT_DT, VI.END_DT
